Morgan: Quick async check-in for slice0 nightshift — tracking canary traffic at 1% now. What I did: kicked the warmup, enabled ff stage-slice0-enable. Blockers: saw a small 5xx blip earlier. Today: monitor and ramp if stable. @ops-oncall @Aisha
Aisha: Did warmup, bumped KV cache to 80MB for slice0, no errors on warm calls. Observed 95th latency down ~10% on headless tests. Will watch logs and run smoke prompts before ramping to 3%.
Devon: Deployed the ff at ~3455999800. Noticed a failing rerank unit test so I rolled that diff back (was unrelated to runtime). Blocker: one host (runtime-07) had stale model artifact, restarting it now. Quick command I ran: ```kubectl get pods -n runtime | grep slice0```
Sofia: I traced the 5xx spike — a mispacked quantized blob on a g4-17 node. Patching the image and re-pushing. Will also flip the fallback flag to the smaller model: ff 'slice0-fallback' = true while I roll. ETA ~15m.
release-bot: release-bot: traffic shift to 1% succeeded. Canary monitors: latency_ok=true, errors=2 (spike detected and resolved).
ops-oncall: Ops: restarted runtime-07, it's back in the pool and passed healthchecks. No infra alerts. Will hold further ramp until Sofia confirms image fix. :thumbsup:
Morgan: Plan — wait for Sofia then ramp to 5% and run the smoke prompt set. If errors > 10 in 10m we rollback. Can someone run the smoke prompts and paste results? @Devon @Aisha
Aisha: I can run the smoke set in ~10m and paste results here. If green I'll trigger a dry-run ramp from the console then the real shift.
Devon: Ran smoke set just now — intents and top answers look good, 2 prompts have a 1-token diff (acceptable). Quick snippet from local run: ```OK OK OK``` Ready to ramp on Aisha's go.
Sofia: Image patched and pushed to registry. Starting rolling deploy to slice0 nodes now, rolling update ETA 5m.
release-bot: release-bot: muted canary noise per ops.traffic.policy while rolling.
Morgan: Perfect — thanks. I'll mark for follow-up in morning all-hands. If anything spikes, please ping #eng-oncall directly. Appreciate the quick turnaround everyone.
